Maria Chen: starting a quick fastpath smoke probe for release v2.3.0 — target p95 < 150ms on small seq. will gate after ~10m. @Jordan Li @Eileen O'Neil please run a microbench and attach any profiles.

deploy-bot: canary started on cluster-east-1 (canary-id: canary-2187654321) :rocket:

Devon Park: watching dashboards (latency, error-rate, kv cache). will call if anything looks off.

Jordan Li: quick results pasted below:
```
requests: 1000
seq: 64
p50: 45ms
p95: 142ms
```

SRE-Oncall: guardrails: if p95 > 200ms sustained for 3m OR error-rate > 1% pause rollout and notify eng-runtime. tagging ops.

Maria Chen: agreed — rollback criteria = sustained p95 >200ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR errors >1% for 5m. Otherwise proceed to slow expansion. :thumbsup:

Jordan Li: current numbers look within baseline (p95 142ms). uploading perf profile: https://internal/profiles/2187654321 (private) and adding notes to PR #3214.

Devon Park: KV cache hit ~92%, no sign of cache thrash. dashboards green. recommending continue to +10 nodes in canary.

Eileen O'Neil: note — if kernel alloc recurs, fallback plan = switch to quantized fastpath variant and re-run smoke for 5m before resuming.

Maria Chen: proceeding with +10 nodes. I'll keep this thread open for the next 15m and file a short post-check snapshot once stable. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

Jordan Li: acked, will annotate the release with numbers and link the profile.

deploy-bot: scaled canary to 10 additional nodes (actioned by Maria Chen)

Maria Chen: closing loop for now; will reopen if any alerts.
